rfam.comment: This family represents the HIV trans-activation response (TAR) element which is known to be required for the trans-activation of the viral promoter and for virus replication. The TAR hairpin acts as a binding site for the Tat protein and this interaction stimulates the activity of the long terminal repeat promoter [1]. Further experiments have shown that TAR acts as a miRNA that protects against apoptosis [2,3].
